name: BŌSŌZOKU
source:
Set in the aftermath of Japan’s industrial boom, urban life has become difficult — even suffocating. In a bid for some modicum of freedom, many citizens have banded together in groups participating in the culture of Bōsōzoku. These gangs of reckless bikers enable their members to race through the streets, feeling the rush of wind on their faces and of adrenaline in their veins. You, as one of the city’s most promising students, are in such a gang. When word arrives that opposing members, new to the scene, are causing trouble, the responsibility of stopping them no longer falls on the shoulders of the police. It’s up to you, as well as the other three members of the Red Dragons, to root out the source and stamp it out.

[From [url=https://clemenlime-studios.itch.io/bosozoku]Itch.io[/url]]
